The smallest ratio is 11/3 ≈ 3.667, which matches Solution 2's final answer of about 3.67.

**Derivation.** Place D=(0,0), C=(130,0), A=(0,33), B=(18,33). Line BC is 33x+112y−4290=0. The conics through all four vertices form the pencil

x(33x+112y−4290) + k·y(y−33) = 0.

Its quadratic part is 33x²+112xy+ky², so the shape depends only on the matrix [[33,56],[56,k]]. It is an ellipse when k > 56²/33 ≈ 95.

The axis ratio is the square root of the eigenvalue ratio (S+Δ)/(S−Δ), where S=(k+33)/2 and Δ=½√((k−33)²+112²). Let t=Δ/S, so t² = ((k−33)²+112²)/(k+33)². Writing m=k+33, this is 1 − 132/m + 16900/m².

This is minimized at m = 2·16900/132 ≈ 256, which gives k ≈ 223, inside the allowed range. There t² = 1 − 132²/(4·16900) = 50176/67600, so t = 224/260 = 56/65.

The eigenvalue ratio is (1+t)/(1−t) = (121/65)/(9/65) = 121/9, so the axis ratio is 11/3.

**Checking the solutions.**
- Solution 1 gives (65+√5314)/33 ≈ 4.18, which is wrong.
- Solution 2 reaches about 3.67 numerically, consistent with 11/3.
- Solution 3 ends with "535", which is nonsensical.

CHOICE: 2
